(Japanese: '''燃えよマーシャドー''' ''Get Fired Up, Marshadow!'') is the second chapter of [[Pocket Monsters the Movie: I Choose You! Remix]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Marshadow (M20)|Marshadow]] saves {{OBP|Ken|ICYR}} from [[Borosue]] and his group of {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s.
* Ken asks Marshadow to help defend his [[Ken's grandfather|late grandfather]]'s dojo, but it refuses.
* Marshadow attacks Team Skull at their base.
* Ken and Marshadow defeat Borosue's {{p|Gyarados}} with {{m|Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike}}.
* Marshadow says its farewells to Ken, who promises to become a strong [[Pokémon Trainer]] in the future.
